title: `GPUParticles2/3D` documentation is unclear
body:
### Tested versions

* 4.4.beta2

### System information

N/A

### Issue description

The documentation for [`GPUParticles2D.seed`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_gpuparticles2d.html#class-gpuparticles2d-property-seed) and [`GPUParticles3D.seed`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_gpuparticles3d.html#class-gpuparticles3d-property-seed) is incorrect, and also a bit incomplete, it states that `seed` is only effective if `use_fixed_seed` is `true`, but this is not true. Setting `seed` still works regardless of the value of `use_fixed_seed`. It also doesn't clarify that `seed` is only effective if assigned *before* starting emitting, if set after nothing happens.

The documentation for [`GPUParticles2D.use_fixed_seed`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_gpuparticles2d.html#class-gpuparticles2d-property-use-fixed-seed) and [`GPUParticles3D.use_fixed_seed`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_gpuparticles3d.html#class-gpuparticles3d-property-use-fixed-seed) is also a bit incomplete, and should probably clarify that this does not affect the seed when particles loop, only when reset with `restart`. It can easily be assumed that `use_fixed_seed` makes *each* run of the particles identical. Which is not the case (currently at least). So this would probably benefit from an improvement. This part is probably not necessarily a problem, but should be made more clear to avoid confusion.

The behavior is probably correct as it is, and just needs the documentation to be updated, but worth discussing which should be changed. (And any changes should be done before releasing 4.4)

### Steps to reproduce

Run the MRP

First pay attention to the two leftmost particles:
* Press `Q` to test the fact that `seed` has no effect once the particles are running press, note that nothing happens
* Press `W` to restart the particles without resetting the seed, you will now see that the particles run two different patterns, but will run the same pattern each time once started, and will restart the exact same way each time. Being unaffected by that `use_fixed_seed` is false for these two particle nodes, and the documentation says `seed` isn't effective in this case

Then look at the rightmost one, this one has `use_fixed_seed = true`, and each new emitted particle has its own random pattern, i.e. only the starting state is fixed, press `E` to restart this node to see the effect over again

---

Note that the starting state of GPUParticles are not random currently due to:
* #102182
